entry.title: MX4_EN-V1.11-20260727
entry.content:
Original Innioasis G5 software **MX4_EN-V1.11-20260727**.
- Model: **G5** (Innioasis) - Package: `rom_g5.zip` - Build tag: `MX4_EN-V1.11-20260727` - Build date: 2026-07-27
## Install
1. Download `rom_g5.zip` (every numbered volume if the release has more than one, then `cat rom_g5.zip.* > rom_g5.zip`). 2. Unzip it. Keep the scatter file next to the images. 3. Open SP Flash Tool, choose **Download Only**, load the scatter file from the archive and flash. 4. Or use Innioasis Updater CE: <https://innioasis.app/guide.html>
This wipes the player. Back up music and recordings first.
